title: Replace legacy Host MCP execution with compiled contract runtime
summary: Make Host MCP transport consume only installed compiled-plugin.json contracts and expose the platform-owned provider, evidence, ReviewBatch, and finalization lifecycle.

plugin: compiled declaration of input, checks, dimensions, and semantic instructions

forbiddenResponsibilities: transport import or construction of PluginRegistry
transport import or construction of PlatformRunner
transport import or construction of InteractivePluginController
acceptance: MCP transport lists and runs installed compiled contracts without Python plugin registration
MCP tools accept only pluginId, checkId, scope, provider selection, and ReviewBatch decisions
provider binding, discovery, collection, planning, submission, and finalization are delegated to CompiledInteractiveController
transport fails closed when a compiled contract or provider is unavailable
compiled lifecycle and boundary checks remain green

humanApproval.decision: Approved by continuing the no-compatibility hard cut.
